title: Jamaican-Style Stew with Oozy Rice
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make stew with a twist of Jamaican spices, served over oozy rice.

ingredients.name: jamaican stew mix
ingredients.notes: follow package directions for spice blend

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and bell pepper; cook until tender, 5 minutes.
Add Jamaican stew mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato, beans, and water; stir to combine.
Bring stew to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, 20 minutes.
Fluff cooked oozy rice and serve under the stew.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
